programme.desc: Bad Mood: Bingo is playing Bad Mood with Dad, standing on his feet as Dad stomps around the house, controlling everything Bingo does and causing chaos. S2 E39

programme.title: Yakka Dee
programme.desc: Fox: Dee encourages a friend to say 'fox' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. Today, we see a red fox, a furry fox, a fast fox and a fantastic fox. S4 E19

programme.title: Dinopaws
programme.desc: The Thing That Knew Everything: Gwen meets a group of Dinos who are waiting for The One Who Knows Everything. S1 E33

programme.title: Roots & Fruits
programme.desc: Okra: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the spectacular music duo, Okra, playing the floor piano together in perfect sync. S2 E8

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Swim School: Mum, Dad and Bingo must complete both their classes to pass Swim School but pleasing strict Big Fish instructor Margaret (aka Bluey) is proving very difficult. S2 E33

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Colour Badge: Duggee is painting in his favourite colouring book. The Squirrels want to have a go too. S2 E30

programme.title: Yakka Dee

programme.title: Hey Duggee: Songs
